name: UENI
summary: A done-for-you small-business website, built for you rather than a builder you have to learn: a one-time build fee plus a monthly plan that includes domain, email and a launch call. DIY editing is limited and the seven-day promise often slips.
best_for: small-business owners with no time or tech skills who want a professional site built for them, not another tool to learn
skip_if: you want full control over design, run a real e-commerce store, or need deep customisation and integrations — a DIY builder gives you more freedom
honest_knock: It's done-for-you, which is the appeal and the catch. DIY editing and customisation are limited, e-commerce and integrations are basic, and the most common complaint is the gap between the 7-day promise and reality — slow design turnaround and patchy communication with the team. Expect some upselling.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-09 on www.ueni.com/pricing and re-read unchanged 2026-09-26; every figure below unchanged since the August reading) A done-for-you website, now sold in four tiers rather than one. Every tier carries the same setup fee of $599, currently promoted at $79. Launch is $24.99/mo and covers a custom-designed site, domain and SSL, hosting, one professional email address and 30 days of done-for-you edits. Plus is $59.00/mo and adds unlimited done-for-you edits, four email addresses, advanced SEO, integrations such as live chat and lead forms, promotion on Google, Facebook and Instagram, and VIP phone support. Ecommerce is $99.00/mo and adds a full online store with abandoned cart recovery, social selling, subscriptions and courses, advanced bookings and deposits, automated sales tax and a loyalty programme. Growth is $124.99/mo and adds a dedicated VIP Growth Team, a custom marketing plan, monthly one-on-one sessions and 2,000 words of fresh content a month. A yearly toggle advertises about 17% off: our August capture records $20.83 a month ($249.90 billed annually) on Launch and $49.17 ($590) on Plus, with two-year rates of $18.74 ($449.82) and $44.25 ($1,062). Transaction fees are 0% on every tier and there is a 30-day money-back guarantee.
